title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: Identity provider, SYS-01 and brand PMS user exports; POL-02; SYS-01 review record (February 2026); samples of 25 of 212 terminations, 25 of 70 transfers and 25 of 96 new SYS-01 accounts; all 64 brand PMS accounts; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: Identity provider accounts removed on the termination date for 25 of 25 sampled leavers; brand PMS accounts of 6 of 25 sampled franchised-hotel leavers active 9 to 47 days after termination; 5 of 25 sampled transfers kept their prior SYS-01 role; 25 of 25 sampled new SYS-01 accounts approved; last SYS-01 review February 2026; no monitoring of SYS-01 card display and profile export activity; shared night-audit password unchanged after 4 departures since 2025

title: Control assessment: information flow enforcement
source_system: Firewall rule exports for 7 sites; reachability test from the Resort 2 POS VLAN; walkthrough at Hotel 4
what_it_shows: From the Resort 2 POS VLAN, corporate domain controllers answered on directory ports; at Hotel 4 the terminals, PCs and staff Wi-Fi share one network, the same design as at Hotels 3, 5 and 6

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: SYS-01 permission export (all 162 users); role catalog; CFO list of approved card display roles
what_it_shows: 46 of 162 users hold the full card display permission; the approved role list covers 8

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: Remote access inventory (7 paths); POL-02; VPN and broker configuration; test of the Resort 2 POS vendor and lock vendor tools
what_it_shows: Staff VPN requires MFA; the Resort 2 POS vendor and lock vendor tools run always on with shared vendor logins and no record of authorization under POL-02; connection requirements for the 2 tools are not documented

title: Control assessment: literacy training and awareness
source_system: Training content and completion report; phishing results; interviews with 20 staff across 4 sites
what_it_shows: Completion 96%; quarterly phishing simulations run; content not updated in 2026 for phone-based social engineering aimed at front desks and the CRO; lessons from the 2025 tabletop and 2 suspected skimming reports not reflected in training

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list (2026-07-20); STD-02 draft; MSSP service lead interview
what_it_shows: The Resort 2 POS server, both resort lock servers and Hotels 3 to 6 send no logs to the SIEM; event types for these systems are listed only in the STD-02 draft; no written rationale for the selected event types; no review of event types since the SIEM went live in 2024

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports (May to July 2026); SYS-01 report schedule; Security Manager interview
what_it_shows: The MSSP reviews alerts 24x7 and reports findings monthly; no daily review of CDE logs; no review record for SYS-01 card display and export reports

title: Control assessment: audit record retention
source_system: SIEM retention settings; Resort 2 POS server and lock server log settings
what_it_shows: SIEM keeps 12 months; the Resort 2 POS server and lock servers keep 30 days of logs locally

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Benchmark scans of 10 of 34 servers; firewall and POS workstation settings; STD-01 draft
what_it_shows: 3 of 10 scanned servers missed required settings; remote services left enabled by the POS vendor on the Resort 2 POS server; no configuration baselines for firewalls, POS workstations or lock servers; deviations neither recorded nor approved; configuration changes monitored and controlled through tickets

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: Asset inventory export; payment device lists; reconciliation of 120 payment devices at 6 hotels; walkthroughs at 4 of 7 sites
what_it_shows: The inventory omits 42 payment devices (12 brand terminals and 30 Resort 2 readers) and the Hotels 3 to 6 switches and staff Wi-Fi access points; serial numbers and locations missing for the 42 devices; no reconciliation to the PCI DSS scope on record

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Contingency test records; resort downtime drill reports; lab restore of a Resort 2 lock server backup
what_it_shows: No contingency test records for the lock servers, the data warehouse or the CRM; no effectiveness criteria for restore tests; the lab restore of the Resort 2 lock server backup on 2026-08-13 failed because the backup disk held an incomplete image; resort downtime drill reports reviewed

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports for 31 of 31 July 2026 days; vault settings; lock server backup configuration
what_it_shows: Daily backups of the workloads account ran on 31 of 31 days into the separate write-once backup account; lock servers back up weekly to an unencrypted local disk in the same room as the server

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: Brand PMS account lists (all 64); night auditor interviews at Hotels 3 to 6
what_it_shows: Company-managed accounts are unique; night auditors at 3 of 4 franchised hotels share one brand PMS login

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: MFA sign-in test of 25 of 38 privileged accounts; vendor remote tool test
what_it_shows: 25 of 25 sampled company privileged accounts required MFA; the 2 vendor remote tools give administrator access to the Resort 2 POS server and lock server without MFA

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Identity provider password policy; default-credential test on 6 vendor-managed systems; interface register
what_it_shows: The Resort 2 lock server accepted the lock vendor's default administrator password, which was changed the same evening; local accounts on the POS and lock servers have no strength rule; 4 of 11 interface credentials unchanged since installation; the shared night-audit password is not changed when members leave

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident log (43 incidents, 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-31; 10 sampled); 2025 tabletop report; draft P08 runbooks; MSSP playbook
what_it_shows: In 2 of 10 sampled incidents (a suspected skimmer and a lost brand terminal at franchised hotels) handling stayed with the franchisor and did not reach the incident commander; lessons from the 2025 ransomware tabletop not reflected in procedures

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03; 10 sampled incidents; interviews with 20 staff
what_it_shows: No record that the suspected skimmer at Hotel 5 (2026-03) was reported to the acquirer and no record of who decides acquirer and franchisor notice; referred to the General Counsel and the CFO

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2024 incident response plan; P08 runbooks and notification matrix (drafts during fieldwork); distribution list
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan is in force; the P08 runbooks and notification matrix are drafts; no metrics for the incident response capability; no distribution to hotel front offices, the CRO, the franchisor's incident contact or key vendors; no card compromise exercise held

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Remote tool inventory; vendor session logs; broker configuration; vendor tool test
what_it_shows: Vendor sessions at Resort 2 are not approved per session, monitored, recorded or ended after maintenance and use no strong authentication; broker sessions for cloud workloads are approved, recorded and ended automatically

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Destruction certificates (10 sampled); lease return records
what_it_shows: 10 of 10 sampled destruction certificates on file; 2 leased copiers that store scan images were returned to the lessor in 2026 with no documented wipe

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Terminations sample (25 of 212); brand PMS account lists; exit checklists
what_it_shows: Exit checklists on file; brand PMS access for 6 of 25 sampled leavers not disabled within 1 business day; shared night-audit credentials not changed after departures

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report (2026-07-31); risk appetite statements; audit committee minutes
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment uses SP 800-30, covers every business unit, the cardholder data environment and the franchised hotels, and records owners, treatments and dates

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Internal scan reports (Q1-Q2 2026); ASV reports (4 quarters); 46 of 46 critical and high findings; known-exploited vulnerability log
what_it_shows: Internal scans exclude Hotels 3 to 6; ASV scans passed in the last 4 quarters; 46 of 46 critical and high findings examined; a known-exploited vulnerability on 2 SD-WAN edge devices took 19 days to patch

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Vendor register; AOCs and SOC 2 reports for 31 of 31 card and guest-data vendors; franchise agreements; chatbot contract
what_it_shows: 9 of 31 vendors have no current AOC or SOC 2 report; the chatbot contract has no retention or masking terms; no PCI DSS responsibility matrix with the franchisor, the channel manager or the POS vendors; no record of annual vendor compliance monitoring

title: Control assessment: unsupported system components
source_system: Inventory; vendor support notices; replacement plans
what_it_shows: The Resort 2 POS server and lock server operating systems are out of vendor support; no extended support arranged; replacements planned for 2027

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall exports; reachability test from the Resort 2 POS VLAN; walkthrough at Hotel 4
what_it_shows: External interfaces deny unsolicited inbound traffic; the Resort 2 POS VLAN reaches directory ports on the corporate network; the Hotels 3 to 6 staff networks are flat, with no monitoring between internal zones

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption reports; data discovery scan (2026-07-21); 60 sampled recordings
what_it_shows: Storage and laptops are encrypted; card numbers and security codes are readable to authorized users in 2,860 emails and an estimated 31,000 recordings

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; 14 of 14 critical patches; firmware records
what_it_shows: 12 of 14 critical patches installed within 30 days and 2 after; the Resort 2 POS server and lock server cannot be patched (unsupported); firmware for lock encoders and brand terminals is not tracked

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR console export; 30 sampled PCs; EICAR test files on 5 PCs
what_it_shows: EDR quarantined 5 of 5 test files within 5 minutes; no EDR on 50 PCs at Hotels 3 to 6 or on the 38 Resort 2 POS workstations, whose legacy antivirus agent sends no alerts to the MSSP

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: MSSP reports; simulated impossible-travel sign-in; vendor tool session test
what_it_shows: The MSSP escalated the simulated sign-in in 22 minutes; the vendor tool sessions at Resort 2 raised no alert; no monitoring of the Resort 2 POS, the lock servers or Hotels 3 to 6; no intrusion detection at the Resort 2 CDE boundary; no rule for use of the card display permission

title: Control assessment: software, firmware and information integrity
source_system: EDR integrity policy; browser capture of the booking pages (23 scripts); terminal firmware records
what_it_shows: EDR detects changes to critical files on monitored PCs; no integrity verification of the 23 booking page scripts or of brand terminal firmware; no defined action for unauthorized changes to payment pages or firmware

title: Control assessment: inspection of systems or components
source_system: Inspection logs (13 weeks at 6 hotels); physical inspection of 30 payment devices
what_it_shows: Logged weekly inspections only at Resort 1; inspections at the other hotels are informal with no log; 30 of 30 inspected devices showed no sign of tampering
